chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But upon those who take him as a guardian.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/master

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority (*sulṭān*) is not an inherent dominion over all believers but is conditional upon their voluntary acceptance of him as a master. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle of free will, where spiritual subjugation results from specific choices rather than predestined fate, reinforcing the believer's capacity to resist through conscious adherence.
